parameters.formDescription: Every request that waits for a person: urgent, fixed-date, low-confidence or flagged, and every proposed split. Confirm or change each lane, and accept or reject each split. Your name and reason go into the log with a stamp.

values.option: Every request that waits for a person

parameters.query: select request_id, requester_role, title, body, lane, type, size_hours::float8 as size_hours, due_date::text as due_date, due_breaks, urgent, urgent_harm, goal_id, playbook, split_proposal, confidence::float8 as confidence, triage_reason, flags, confirmation_reasons, triage_stamp, lane_waits, split_waits from changedesk.awaiting_confirmation order by arrived_at, request_id;

options.formDescription: Nothing is planned until you confirm. Your choices are stamped with your name.
